newsitem.title: GREECE: Natl Bank of Greece to issue bonus shares.
newsitem.headline: Natl Bank of Greece to issue bonus shares.

text.p: National Bank of Greece will increase its share capital by raising the nominal value of its shares and distributing bonus shares, it said on Friday.
The bank's share capital increase will be achieved through the increase in the par value of its shares and distribution of one bonus share for every 10 outstanding, it said.
The bonus distribution is the result of a capitalisation of gains from the revaluation of fixed assets, it added.
National Bank has also elected three new members to its board of directors.
The new members are Nikos Kalogeropoulos, Andreas Vranas and Christos Polyzogopoulos who replaced John Ziagas, Spyros Kouniakis and Christos Protopapas, the statement said.
The bank's outstanding shares will be replaced by depositary certificates.
